dtype: E4M3 blockwise FP8 with BF16 dW

methods.forward: Instrumented build, three warmups then one sample, eight rank traces. Per-tile medians pooled across ranks; math includes full-stage waits; epilogue includes ring retirement and publication.
methods.backward: Instrumented build, three warmups then five samples, all eight ranks. Service/wait sums are cumulative CTA elapsed time, not wall latency.
methods.communication: Route-derived off-rank expert assignments only; not hardware NVLink bytes. Ignore legacy BF16 bytes-per-row fields in raw benchmark communication metadata for FP8.

benchmark.forward_ready_timing_scope: eager training forward + device synchronize; checkpoint still live
benchmark.measurement_scope: eager training forward+release+device synchronize; input preparation excluded
benchmark.forward_timing_scope: host API boundary (not synchronized CUDA phase timing)
benchmark.checkpoint: row FP8 X + row FP8 FC1 gate/up; BWD column conversion once; recompute gated SwiGLU in backward
